name: where-to-harness
description: Finds where to go, for a trip or just for dinner tonight. Translates unspoken preferences ("a quiet izakaya", 「うるさくない店がいい」, 「宿にこもるだけだと飽きる」) into search and exclusion terms in the destination's language; the AI searches the web and official sites of hotels and restaurants, compares candidates per constraint, and keeps what's still unconfirmed as questions to ask.
